item.name: Ichor
item.summary: The main persistent currency used for long-term Toon and store progression.
item.usedFor: Buy Toons and Trinkets from Dandy's Store, and buy Skins and Stickers from Dyle's Store.
item.howToEarn: Earn Ichor from completing Machines, collecting Research Capsules, and using a Toon's non-Passive Ability for the first time on a Floor. Sources also document purchase and code reward routes.
item.cardSummary: Use Ichor for persistent unlocks and store purchases between runs.

item.name: Research
item.summary: A persistent research currency tied to studying Twisteds and unlocking research-based progression.
item.usedFor: Track Twisted research and support research-based Toon and Trinket progression, including Twisted descriptions and Research Trinkets.
item.howToEarn: Earn Research by collecting Research Capsules and encountering Twisteds during runs.
item.cardSummary: Build Research by investigating Twisteds and collecting their Capsules.

item.name: Tapes
item.summary: The temporary currency collected and spent during an active run.
item.usedFor: Buy Items at Dandy's Shop in the Elevator and activate certain Toon Abilities.
item.howToEarn: Earn Tapes from floor pickups, Machines, surviving Floors, using Toon Abilities, encountering Twisteds, and using Items.
item.resetBehavior: Resets when the run ends and does not carry between runs.
item.cardSummary: Budget Tapes during a run for shop Items and tape-cost abilities.
